title: CUMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
findings: The proposed model, CUMA, which uses demographic information including religion to route inputs to specialized adapters, more effectively aligns with diverse cultural values compared to standard models. It avoids collapsing conflicting values (a phenomenon termed 'Mean Collapse') into a generic average. The model spontaneously learns to cluster demographic profiles (e.g., creating an 'African-Islamic bloc') based on shared value systems, enabling it to generate more culturally and religiously resonant responses.

measurement_description: Predicting value stances on various topics, conditioned on a user's demographic profile which includes their religion. The model is evaluated on its ability to align with the values of specific cultural groups, where religion is a key defining attribute.
